doc.overviewContent: Certificates are the foundation of network security communication, used for identity verification (such as TLS/SSL) and data encryption. This module supports storing and managing digital certificates of various standards for network components (such as MQTT, HTTP, TCP) to enable encrypted transmission or mutual authentication.
doc.serverContent: When running as a server (such as MQTT Broker), you need to configure the certificate and the corresponding private key. The private key is strictly confidential and used to decrypt client data.
doc.clientContent: When connecting to external services as a client, you need to configure a trust certificate to verify the legitimacy of the remote service.
doc.pemContent: Text format, starting with -----BEGIN... Supports direct pasting of content or uploading via button.
doc.binaryContent: Binary container format. After uploading the file, you must fill in the correct "Keystore Password" to properly load the key information within it.
doc.trustTip: Tip: If mutual authentication is enabled, please ensure that the "Truststore" or "Trust Certificate" is correctly configured, otherwise the connection will be interrupted due to verification failure.

checklist.title: Configuration Checklist
checklist.item1: Confirm certificate file matches private key content (PEM only)
checklist.item2: Is the Keystore/Truststore password filled in correctly?
checklist.item3: Is the "Truststore" uploaded when mutual authentication is enabled?
checklist.item4: Check if the certificate validity period has expired
